services.desc: The Charleston Music Hall was originally a train station built in 1850 and was transformed into a performing arts facility in 1994 by the Bennett-Hofford Company. Perfect For Weddings, Company Parties, Birthday & Anniversary Celebrations, Private Concerts, Fundraisers, Product Launches, Holiday Parties, & more! Centrally located in the Upper King Street area of historic downtown Charleston, SC, the Charleston Music Hall was built in 1850 as a passenger station for the South Carolina Railroad, then converted to a full-service music venue in 1995.
